studies.headline: The encoder and the alignment transfer; the decoder does not (64% → 1.4% composition recovery). This dataset gave the density rule that picks the mode before training.

studies.headline: The best encoder of any dataset on the smallest training set (0.19 spreads, r 0.97); the decoder cannot generate (0%), as the preview predicted; screening returned 13 metastable, formula-novel candidates in known structure types.
studies.title: An external upload (246 structures)

studies.headline: Requested band gap in, relaxed structures out: 4 accepted from 175 generated (1 new composition, 2 new polymorphs of a known formula, 1 known structure found again); of the 37 relaxed cells, 20 collapsed and 4 were slabs or sparse cells, all set aside.
studies.title: MP-20

studies.headline: An independent user's journey on public data: S0 said screen, not generate, and the trained decoder agreed. Screening and family generation returned 7 A₂BB′X₆ compositions absent from the data and from JARVIS-DFT inside the requested gap window, 6 of them within 0.1 eV/atom of the hull with one potential for every phase.
studies.mode: screening (as S0 said), with family and family-free generation beside it
studies.title: Double perovskites from public JARVIS-DFT data
